workflow.title: Choose the actual next destination
actions: Read approved current position, revealed passages, resources, faction outcomes and the chosen objective.
Prepare only the next reachable sector and a return route. Level 2 is the next conditional floor; completion of three Level 1 contracts does not itself unlock it.

workflow.title: Check source topology
actions: Read the floor map and exact adjacent room keys. Preserve north, grid, doors, secret walls, elevations, stairs and hazards.
Create one source-coordinate master and derive crops without reshaping corridors. Keep keyed labels private.
List every entry and exit as stairs, tunnel, river, shaft, gate or specific exception. Keep unknown lengths null.

workflow.title: Keep custom hooks separate
actions: Assign an optional hook only to a plausible unsearched room or custodian with an approved source.
Keep an unknown exact room null. Provide refusal, early retreat or city follow-up. No character, item, death, ownership claim or revelation is compulsory.

workflow.title: Prepare play and privacy
actions: Private layer: source keys, stat references, traps, secret passages, custody, hooks, conditional refuges and actual response paths.
Public layer: reviewed unkeyed geometry; conceal secret areas with separate scenes or fog. An unkeyed whole floor still reveals its entire layout.
Calibrate the authored five-foot tactical grid against ten-foot source squares. Preserve existing scenes, fog and tokens; offer a separate variant only by explicit opt-in.

workflow.title: Review the next-floor boundary
actions: Trace the complete approach from the actual earned position; do not jump directly to stairs.
Prepare receiving area, departure area and reverse retreat. Check a gate’s destination, activation, minimum level, elder rune and return requirements separately.
Record the visible entry signal, turnback condition and refuge conditions; no universal safe-room flag.

workflow.title: Run and retain outcomes
actions: Opening, staging or preparing does not move creatures, advance time, locate places, award loot, change resources or complete quests.
After play record exact turnpoint, doors, hazards, surviving relocations, agreements and custody through the existing review. Reuse the saved dungeon.
Select the next likely sector; leave other floors as logical references until needed.
